**1 — Scene:** A small serving of cooked grains mixed with leafy greens and vegetables, alongside two corn-on-the-cob sections.

**2 — Vessel:** A large square dinner plate, approximately 26 cm across. Using the requested circular approximation: 3.14 × 13² ≈ **530 cm²**.

**3 — Items:** Brown cooked grains, leafy greens, orange/red vegetable strips, a few pale vegetable pieces, and corn. No separate oil or dressing is clearly visible.

| Leafy greens | 5% | 27 × 2 = 54 ml | 0.15 | 8 g | 25 | 2 kcal |
| Vegetable strips and pale pieces | 3% | 16 × 1.3 = 21 ml | 0.6 | 13 g | 40 | 5 kcal |
| Corn sections, including cob | 10% | 53 × 3 = 159 ml | 0.65 | 103 g | 65* | 67 kcal |

The areas total **34% of the plate**, consistent with the substantial empty space.  
*Corn energy is expressed per gram of the whole section, including the inedible cob; the kernels themselves are more energy-dense.*

**8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **226 g including the corn cobs**, and **202 kcal**, is plausible for this modest portion. Grain identity and any unobservable cooking oil are the main uncertainties.
